name: Amanyara
insider_take: Amanyara is where barefoot luxury meets raw Caribbean wilderness — a sanctuary so seamlessly woven into the coral landscape of Turks & Caicos that it feels less like a resort and more like a private universe unto itself.
whats_special: Nestled within the 3,000-acre Providenciales nature reserve, Amanyara sits directly alongside one of the world's most pristine coral reef systems — the Caicos Bank. Its name means "peaceful place" in Sanskrit, and Aman delivers on that promise with dramatic pavilion-style villas that open directly to turquoise waters. The resort partners with the Amanyara Marine Conservation Program, offering guests a rare chance to participate in coral restoration and sea turtle monitoring alongside marine biologists.
pro_tip: Book a villa on the North or South Reef side for direct snorkeling access straight from your deck — the reef is so close you'll spot eagle rays and nurse sharks before breakfast. Ask the concierge about the private "Reef Discovery" sunrise snorkel before other guests are even awake.
dont_miss: The twice-weekly Fish House dining experience — a candlelit dinner served on a private dock suspended over the water — is nothing short of magical. Also, Grace Bay Beach, consistently ranked among the world's top beaches, is just minutes away, while the resort's yoga pavilion offers open-air sessions with uninterrupted ocean panoramas that rival any view on the planet.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Northwest Point Beach
Ultra-luxury pavilions and villas with private pools and ocean views
World-class Aman Spa with holistic wellness treatments
cons: Ultra-premium pricing reflects exclusive luxury positioning
Remote location requires planning for off-property dining and activities
